articles.title: Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas - Official Launch Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Watch the latest Age of Wonders 4 trailer to see what to expect from The Silver Seas expansion, which brings expanded ocean gameplay, two new forms, new Mercantile culture, and more to the strategy game. The Silver Seas expansion for Age of Wonders 4 is out now, and it is included in Expansion Pass 4 alongside two more expansions which will be available in 2027. Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas adds a new culture focused around sailing, trade, and secrets, along with new aquatic physical forms and tomes of new spells for land and sea alike. Explore oceans rich with mystery, master the tides to claim their hidden treasures, and become the undisputed ruler of the waves.The Silver Seas expansion centers around the new Mercantile culture, built on turning every deal, alliance, and rivalry into profit. Place cities on both land and sea, and expand your influence. Venture and discover new world map content, including a pirate dwelling with a variety of possible captains at the helm, each with their own personalities, benefits, demands, and stories to tell. The map is also awash in new aquatic events, Landmarks, Ancient Wonders, and Infestations of the sea, and a new Magic Material to fuel your empireThe expansion is included in Expansion Pass 4 alongside two more expansions plundering their way to shore in 2027.
